body.name: Bounded-aspect sharp-constant experiment
body.construction: Fix \(\gamma\in(c_-,c_+)\), set \(n_\ell=2\ell\) and \(m_\ell=2\lceil\gamma\ell\rceil\), and define \(C_\star=\liminf_{\ell\to\infty}\inf_{\widetilde U\in\mathfrak E_{n_\ell,m_\ell}}\sup_{P\in\mathfrak P^{\mathrm{pred}}_{n_\ell,m_\ell}(r,\mu,K,q,B,\lambda)}E_P[\mathcal L(\widetilde U,U)]/b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\).
inputs: A fixed aspect limit and the predictable experiment class.
